demo.title: cryptofeed402.sh
demo.code:
# Free: current extreme funding and majors (no payment)
curl -s https://cryptofeed402.site/brief/teaser

# Perps radar for one Hyperliquid perp: funding, OI, premium, rank ($0.002)
bankr x402 call https://cryptofeed402.site/perps/HYPE --max-payment 0.002

# 10 most extreme funding rates on Hyperliquid ($0.0025)
bankr x402 call https://cryptofeed402.site/funding/extreme --max-payment 0.0025

# News sentiment for a major ($0.002)
bankr x402 call https://cryptofeed402.site/sentiment/BTC --max-payment 0.002

# Or ask the agent
bankr prompt "Use the cryptofeed402 skill: pre-trade check on SOL perps, show the cost first"

setup: No account or API key: every paid route is plain HTTPS behind x402 (USDC on Base, eip155:8453)
Hold a little USDC on Base in the Bankr wallet; a full pre-trade check costs at most $0.0065
Pay with `bankr x402 call <url> --max-payment <route price>`; never use -y
Check response shapes for free first: https://cryptofeed402.site/samples
Data only, not a trade recommendation; always show the as_of time
